The '''Pinett Freedom Force''' was an organization that was formed by some of the inhabitants of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pinett]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], to peacefully protest against the actions of the [[Corsignis Property Alliance]] and the [[Jon-Tow Economic Development Group]], two rival factions that had [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] Pinett as result of a trade dispute. The protesters attempted to prevent Corsignis and Jon-Tow [[Starship/Legends|starships]] from landing on Pinett and the group's leader, the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Daetan Taakses]], went on a hunger strike. During this period, a group of agents traveled to Pinett and on their arrival on the world, they were greeted by a delegation from the Freedom Force. However, a group of port workers, who were disgruntled by the Freedom Force's disruption of trade on Pinett, attacked the delegation and attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Taakses, in an attempt to bring the protest to an end. The agents intervened and they saved Taakses.

A short time afterward, a small group of Freedom Force protesters occupied the landing pad [[A-13]], in an attempt to prevent ships from landing on the pad. However, they inadventently activated a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] in the pad, pulling a Jon-Tow [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] out of [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] and sending the vessel hurtling towards Pinett. The newly-arrived agents tried to prevent the freighter from crashing, and Taakses subsequently requested that the agents help the Freedom Force to bring the trade dispute to a resolution.
